title: Moroccan Beef Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful tagine dish made with ground beef and a blend of mediterranean spices. The silky texture of the sauce and the zesty kick of the spices make this a standout meal.

ingredients.name: Tagine Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality, extra virgin oil

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and silky tomato paste. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
